title: Ransomware Outbreak
briefing: Multiple systems begin displaying encryption warnings and ransom notes. The organization must quickly determine how far the infection has spread and whether containment measures can limit the damage.

injects.title: Encryption Spreading
injects.message: Monitoring systems report additional hosts beginning to encrypt files across multiple departments.

injects.title: Backup Integrity Question
injects.message: Infrastructure teams warn that backup systems may also have been accessed before the ransomware triggered.

injects.title: Media Attention
injects.message: Industry journalists begin asking questions about possible outages linked to your organization.

step_1.situation: Several users report that files have become inaccessible and ransom notes appear on their desktops.

if_correct.consequence: The team correctly recognizes signs of ransomware activity and begins containment procedures.

if_incorrect.consequence: The issue is initially misdiagnosed, allowing the ransomware to continue spreading.

step_2.situation: Security teams attempt to determine how the ransomware entered the network.

if_correct.consequence: Initial infection vectors are identified and further compromise paths begin to narrow.

if_incorrect.consequence: Failure to identify the infection vector slows containment and allows lateral movement.

step_3.situation: The team evaluates network segmentation and system isolation to prevent additional encryption events.

if_correct.consequence: Isolation procedures limit the ability of the ransomware to reach additional systems.

if_incorrect.consequence: Weak containment measures allow ransomware to continue spreading internally.

step_4.situation: Executives ask whether the organization should negotiate with attackers, restore from backups, or shut down systems entirely.

if_correct.consequence: A balanced recovery strategy limits operational damage while restoring key services.

if_incorrect.consequence: Unclear recovery strategy delays response and increases operational disruption.

step_5.situation: The organization prepares to communicate publicly about the incident while continuing recovery operations.

if_correct.consequence: Transparent communication and recovery planning preserve customer confidence.

if_incorrect.consequence: Poor communication increases reputational damage and public scrutiny.
